name: pr-tools
description: Pull request review and fix loops inside your Claude Code session.

plugins.name: pr-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews each pull request push in your session: read-only agents, one against what the linked issues, spec and description ask, two against the project's written decisions and guidelines (including ones fetched from other GitHub repositories) and two for bugs, a validator confirms each finding, and a PR comment with a walkthrough, inline comments and a pr-reviewer commit status are posted. Hands findings to pr-fixer when installed.

plugins.name: pr-fixer
plugins.description: Fixes pull request review findings from any reviewer: checks each against the code, fixes each confirmed one everywhere it occurs, runs the project's checks and pushes, then answers every review conversation: resolves the ones addressed, and replies to the ones it disagrees with, leaving them open.
